Truth is complete reality or what is itself the source of ideas and the intelligible world (ibid., 2,12,33); not something phenomenal and apparent, but existing in itself and fully real, whose existence is pure, simple, truly. God is this first subsistent Truth, Truth by essence, cause and source of all truth, in whom everything that is true exists and in whom everything that is true participates.
